headline: Personas earn a wider role only if they predict Go Big
annotation: Personas complement real client interviews; they never replace them.
source: Source: case study brief (Nov 2026); P&I proposal.
notes: If asked about personas: the tool is nearly finished. We build personas for the Go Big segments, pre-test the messages in January, then compare what they predicted with what actually happened in the holdout groups.
Only if the predictions are close do we use personas to pre-test every campaign. Either way, they complement real client interviews, never replace them.
